art_direction: 奶油底、同色杏橙椭圆眼，长白高光与小圆嘴。
composition_variation: Two irregular oval ring eyes, hand-cut shapes with a thin soft-black outer contour, a broad single-colored iris band and a very large slightly irregular black oval pupil. BOTH colored iris bands are exactly the same hue. Left eye slightly smaller and a little lower; right eye about 20 percent larger and higher. Left oval occupies x=.17 to .43,y=.39 to .65; right oval x=.58 to .87,y=.30 to .65. The black pupil fills approximately 68 percent of each eye width; its oval is gently organic and not mathematically circular. One long narrow ivory painted glint near upper-left inside each black pupil, slanted the same way. Restrained flat handmade shapes and tiny contour imperfections, no eyeball whites or human anatomy. A tiny soft-black oval mouth centered below the gap at x=.50,y=.72, only 3 percent of image width: a small quiet 'oh' expression, no smile. The overall expression is gently interested and quietly surprised, not scared or vacant. No eyebrows and no other face marks. Keep generous space all around.
